initiatives.name: Share Buyback Programme Acceleration
initiatives.summary: Kingfisher accelerated its fourth £300m share buyback programme after receiving £94m in exceptional cash inflows from an EU state aid tax refund (£64m) and the Romania business sale (£33m), demonstrating confidence in long-term strategy.

evidence.title: Share buyback programme acceleration using one-off proceeds
evidence.summary: Kingfisher accelerated its fourth £300m share buyback programme after receiving £94m in exceptional cash inflows from an EU state aid tax refund (£64m) and the Romania business sale (£33m), demonstrating confidence in long-term strategy.
evidence.quote: After Kingfisher saw £94m exceptional cash inflows, primarily from an EU state aid tax refund (£64m) and from the sale of the Romania business (£33m), the Board considered an acceleration of the Programme.

initiatives.name: Romania Business Divestment
initiatives.summary: Kingfisher completed the divestment of its Brico Dépôt Romania business, generating £33m in cash proceeds. This impacted like-for-like sales by (1.6)% and contributed to reduced losses in territories without recognized tax credits.

evidence.title: Disposal of Romania business
evidence.summary: Kingfisher completed the divestment of its Brico Dépôt Romania business, generating £33m in cash proceeds. This impacted like-for-like sales by (1.6)% and contributed to reduced losses in territories without recognized tax credits.
evidence.quote: limited losses recorded in Brico Dépôt Romania following the Group's divestment of the business on 2 May 2025. ... Disposal of Romania 33 - ... LFL sales of +1.1% excludes a (1.6)% impact from the disposal of Romania

initiatives.name: Koçtaş Joint Venture Impairment
initiatives.summary: Kingfisher recognized a £19m impairment of its joint venture Koçtaş, reflecting challenging trading conditions and macroeconomic uncertainty in Turkey, reducing the carrying value of the investment to nil.

evidence.title: Impairment of Koçtaş joint venture in Turkey
evidence.summary: Kingfisher recognized a £19m impairment of its joint venture Koçtaş, reflecting challenging trading conditions and macroeconomic uncertainty in Turkey, reducing the carrying value of the investment to nil.
evidence.quote: The charges also include a £19m impairment of the Group's joint venture, Koçtaş, reflecting the continued challenging trading environment and ongoing macro‑economic uncertainty in Turkey. Following this impairment, the carrying amount of the investment has been reduced to nil.

initiatives.name: Sustainable Home Products Portfolio Growth
initiatives.summary: Kingfisher targeted 60% of Group sales from Sustainable Home Products (SHPs) by FY25/26, achieving 58.2%, with OEB SHP sales reaching 70.1%, exceeding that target. The Green Star mark was rolled out across all banners with SKUs carrying the mark doubling to approximately 20,000.

evidence.title: Sustainable Home Products sales target
evidence.summary: Kingfisher targeted 60% of Group sales from Sustainable Home Products (SHPs) by FY25/26, achieving 58.2%, with OEB SHP sales reaching 70.1%, exceeding that target. The Green Star mark was rolled out across all banners with SKUs carrying the mark doubling to approximately 20,000.
evidence.quote: Attain 60% of Group sales from our Sustainable Home Products (SHPs), including 70% of sales for our Own Exclusive Brand (OEB) products by FY 25/26. - 58.2 % of total Group sales came from SHPs that help create greener, healthier homes (FY 24/25: 53.4%)... Rolled out our Green Star mark across all banners, making it easier for customers to identify and shop for products with a lower environmental impact. The number of SKUs carrying the mark doubled this year to approximately 20,000.

initiatives.name: Responsibly Sourced Wood and Paper Sourcing Target
initiatives.summary: Kingfisher targeted 100% responsibly sourced wood and paper for products and catalogues by FY25/26, achieving 99.4% for products and 100% for catalogue paper, building on 30 years of responsible sourcing legacy.

evidence.title: Responsibly sourced wood and paper target
evidence.summary: Kingfisher targeted 100% responsibly sourced wood and paper for products and catalogues by FY25/26, achieving 99.4% for products and 100% for catalogue paper, building on 30 years of responsible sourcing legacy.
evidence.quote: Achieve 100% responsibly sourced wood and paper for our products and catalogues by FY 25/26. ... we have reached a level of 99,4%1 responsibly sourced wood and paper (FY 24/25: 97.9% ). We also maintained 100% responsibly sourced catalogue paper

initiatives.name: Digital Ecosystem and Marketplace Expansion
initiatives.summary: Kingfisher is expanding its digital ecosystem including online marketplaces now live across all markets, loyalty programmes, apps, and retail media capabilities. This is designed to drive traffic, broaden product choice via third-party sellers, and build data capabilities for monetisation.

evidence.title: Scaling digital ecosystem with marketplaces and apps
evidence.summary: Kingfisher is expanding its digital ecosystem including online marketplaces now live across all markets, loyalty programmes, apps, and retail media capabilities. This is designed to drive traffic, broaden product choice via third-party sellers, and build data capabilities for monetisation.
evidence.quote: Our e-commerce sales (excluding Screwfix) grew +20%, taking our e-commerce penetration to 21% of Group sales. This was up 2 ppts year-on-year (and up 15 ppts versus FY19/20). By the end of the year, Group GMV (the value attributed to sales through marketplaces) was up +58% to £518m, representing 15% of total e-commerce sales

initiatives.name: Trade Business Expansion with £5bn Ambition
initiatives.summary: Kingfisher is growing its trade customer proposition across banners through dedicated trade zones, loyalty programmes, and expanded trade-focused ranges. Trade sales reached £3.9bn with an updated ambition to reach £5bn in the medium term.

evidence.title: Expanding trade business with £5bn medium-term ambition
evidence.summary: Kingfisher is growing its trade customer proposition across banners through dedicated trade zones, loyalty programmes, and expanded trade-focused ranges. Trade sales reached £3.9bn with an updated ambition to reach £5bn in the medium term.
evidence.quote: Trade sales reached £3.9bn in total. Our updated ambition is to reach £5bn Group trade sales in the medium term. Across the Group, trade customer sales (excluding Screwfix) increased +23% year-on-year, now representing 30% of sales (up 3 ppts).

initiatives.name: Apprenticeship and Training Programme Scaling
initiatives.summary: Kingfisher is enabling colleagues to complete apprenticeships, traineeships, or formal qualifications, targeting 20,000 by FY30/31. In FY25/26, 4,410 colleagues completed such programmes, bringing the cumulative total to 12,658 since FY23/24.

evidence.title: Apprenticeship and training programme target
evidence.summary: Kingfisher is enabling colleagues to complete apprenticeships, traineeships, or formal qualifications, targeting 20,000 by FY30/31. In FY25/26, 4,410 colleagues completed such programmes, bringing the cumulative total to 12,658 since FY23/24.
evidence.quote: Enable more than 20,000 colleagues to complete an apprenticeship, traineeship or formal qualification by FY 30/31. ... 4,410 colleagues across the Group completed apprenticeships, traineeships and formal qualifications, bringing the total to 12,658 since FY 23/24. This progress brings us on track to achieve our 2030 target.

initiatives.name: Head Office Reorganisation and Operating Model Transformation
initiatives.summary: Kingfisher evolved its operating model with Head Office reviews identifying opportunities to streamline processes, including a head office reorganisation at Castorama France to strengthen operational effectiveness and sharpen customer experience focus.

evidence.title: Operating model transformation and head office reorganisation
evidence.summary: Kingfisher evolved its operating model with Head Office reviews identifying opportunities to streamline processes, including a head office reorganisation at Castorama France to strengthen operational effectiveness and sharpen customer experience focus.
evidence.quote: We continued to evolve our operating model, with Head Office reviews identifying opportunities to streamline processes and unlock productivity, alongside organisational changes delivered across the banners. At Castorama France, a head office reorganisation streamlined processes and strengthened operational effectiveness, sharpening the focus on delivering an improved customer experience.

initiatives.name: Capital Expenditure Increase for Store and Technology Investment
initiatives.summary: Kingfisher increased gross capital expenditure to £388m, up 22% year-on-year, driven by freehold acquisitions at B&Q, investment in technology, and customer-facing maintenance in existing stores.

evidence.title: Increased capital expenditure on stores and technology
evidence.summary: Kingfisher increased gross capital expenditure to £388m, up 22% year-on-year, driven by freehold acquisitions at B&Q, investment in technology, and customer-facing maintenance in existing stores.
evidence.quote: Gross capital expenditure was £388m, up £71m (+22%) through freehold acquisitions at B&Q, investment in technology and in customer facing maintenance in our existing stores.

initiatives.name: Net Zero Commitments and Science-Based Emissions Targets
initiatives.summary: Kingfisher committed to reaching net zero emissions for operations (Scope 1&2) by FY40/41 and across its value chain (Scope 3) by FY50/51, exceeding its FY25/26 science-based targets with 68.7% reduction in Scope 1&2 and 45.9% reduction in Scope 3 emissions intensity. New near-term targets were set for FY30/31.

evidence.title: Net zero commitments and science-based emissions targets
evidence.summary: Kingfisher committed to reaching net zero emissions for operations (Scope 1&2) by FY40/41 and across its value chain (Scope 3) by FY50/51, exceeding its FY25/26 science-based targets with 68.7% reduction in Scope 1&2 and 45.9% reduction in Scope 3 emissions intensity. New near-term targets were set for FY30/31.
evidence.quote: Reach net zero emissions for our operations (Scope 1 and 2) by FY 40/41 and across our value chain (Scope 3) by FY 50/51. ... Exceeded our FY 25/26 science-based targets, delivering 68.7% reductions in Scope 1 and 2 emissions and 45.9% reductions in Scope 3 emissions from supply chain and product use per £m of turnover.

initiatives.name: People and Culture Plan 2026-2029

This includes new OKR frameworks, feedback training, and refined incentive structures across banners.

evidence.title: People and Culture Plan 2026-2029 launched
evidence.summary: Kingfisher launched a multi-year People and Culture Plan focused on building an agile, high-performance organisation with priorities around culture, lean operating models, and talent development. This includes new OKR frameworks, feedback training, and refined incentive structures across banners.
evidence.quote: Our People and Culture Plan for 2026–2029 is a core part of the 'Powered by Kingfisher' strategy and focuses on building an organisation that delivers performance and growth.

initiatives.name: Supply Chain and Logistics Roadmap Modernization
initiatives.summary: Kingfisher updated its supply and logistics three-year roadmap to address future logistics capacity needs, diversify sourcing footprint, and enhance resilience amid volatile global supply chains including China sourcing pressure and tariff-driven challenges.

evidence.title: Three-year supply chain and logistics roadmap update
evidence.summary: Kingfisher updated its supply and logistics three-year roadmap to address future logistics capacity needs, diversify sourcing footprint, and enhance resilience amid volatile global supply chains including China sourcing pressure and tariff-driven challenges.
evidence.quote: Our supply and logistics three-year roadmap was updated in 2025/26. It considers our future logistics capacity needs, based on the various sourcing, inventory and sales-generative strategies identified in the Group's strategic planning activities. ... Our OEB supplier strategy includes initiatives to diversify our 'sourcing footprint', build alternative sources where possible and guidance on sourcing regions to enhance resilience.

initiatives.name: Cost Reduction and Structural Savings Programme
initiatives.summary: Kingfisher is structurally reducing its cost base and improving inventory management as part of an agile operating model. Operating costs increases were partly offset by structural savings delivered through a cost-reduction programme and targeted flexing of staffing levels in France and Poland.

evidence.title: Cost-reduction programme and structural savings
evidence.summary: Kingfisher is structurally reducing its cost base and improving inventory management as part of an agile operating model. Operating costs increases were partly offset by structural savings delivered through a cost-reduction programme and targeted flexing of staffing levels in France and Poland.
evidence.quote: These increases were partly offset by structural savings delivered through our cost-reduction programme, alongside targeted actions in France and Poland to flex staffing levels and discretionary spend.

initiatives.name: Data and AI for Digital Journey Optimization
initiatives.summary: Kingfisher is using data and AI to optimise the digital shopping journey for customers and to increase productivity across the business. This is part of the broader digital ecosystem strategy supporting retail media capabilities.

evidence.title: Leveraging data and AI for digital journey and productivity
evidence.summary: Kingfisher is using data and AI to optimise the digital shopping journey for customers and to increase productivity across the business. This is part of the broader digital ecosystem strategy supporting retail media capabilities.
evidence.quote: We are leveraging data and AI to optimise the digital shopping journey. Our apps drive customer loyalty and engagement. With over 1bn annual visits across our digital channels, we are offering vendors a powerful platform to showcase their products through our growing retail media capability. We are also using data and AI to increase productivity across our business.
